svg.title: Q-NEXUS stack
svg.desc: Frontend: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Zustand, Recharts, React Router. Backend: Fastify 5, Node.js, Zod, MCP SDK. Data: PostgreSQL 18, Plain SQL migrations, SheetJS, unpdf. AI: AI gateway, Read-only MCP tools. Ops: Nginx, GitHub Actions, Playwright, Microsoft 365 Graph
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
